text: You live in a small flat in a panel block in Budapest. In here, nothing can hurt you. Every night, you go out.
Stop it. It's just shadows. It's just shadows. …Was someone standing there?
Check what? It was her, I know my own daughter's voice! …She was crying. I can't sit down, I have to find the money.
Szia, drágám, it is Nagyi. I am at the hospital and the nurse needs 20 000 forints for my medicine. Read me the numbers, quick!
Exactly. Paying tells them we're a school that pays, and there's no guarantee anyway. I'm calling the head and the police.
Good evening. Night mode is on. Memory from yesterday, 23:04: scared of the dark. Would you like to hear it again?
